correctness.rationale: The Rule 54 truth table gives the stated four pair-state matrices and indexed cyclic trace, without quotienting rotations. The active one-bit block satisfies B_active^3=B_active+I and has Perrin traces at positive exponents; C_k has the Padovan traces from k=1 onward. Idempotence after two zeros reduces longer zero-runs to pairs. A cyclic list with a non-C1 factor can always choose a nonexceptional neighboring pair for the next merge; an all-C1 list of length >=3 starts with the triple merge. A strict trace gain at the final merge suffices even when earlier entrywise gains are masked. Two C1's alone give 3, below P_(n-2) for n>=8. For a single zero-run, fewer than n sites after truncation gives strictness by Padovan growth. Filling isolated zeros is nondecreasing by B^3>=BAB. For a last fill reaching the double-zero target, the strict gap g(a,b) applies, and when there was never an adjacent pair the single-zero comparison suffices. Recurrence reductions with a reduced coordinate >=4 stay in the appropriate positive/base domains, in particular a+b>=5 for g. All-zero has fiber 2. Independent `cd /workspace && python3 review_replay.py 3` derived the matrices from the truth table, checked 35 pair bases (minimum trace gain 1) and 30 singleton-removal bases (minimum gap 3), verified the three comparison seeds (10,4,1), (12,5,2), (17,7,2), and exhaustively checked indexed fibers through n=18 starting at n=8. The proof carries the infinite claim; the frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
